public_source_heads.source_scope: Windows raw-fd API/position semantics, release-level locking correctness, dependency floor selection

exact_continuation: First settle candidate013 as a durable-vs-live projection contract: promote round.review.started to signal, split payload-conditional engineer.progress out of durable Mission View semantics, and add the default-sink + Web snapshot invariant/regression. Then source-map/implement candidate009/011 shared event authority with portalocker>=4.2, existing os.open(...,0600) raw fd + LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB, retrying only AlreadyLocked, pre-rotation one-byte delimiter isolation, and byte-based stable physical-row iteration. POSIX readers may pin handles/end offsets under shared flock; Windows correctness scans hold exclusive event authority. Next enforce events.lock -> mission-view.lock, then finish PlannerVerdict FOUND/ABSENT/UNKNOWN and explicit iter_call_events corruption behavior. Keep candidate008 durability and candidate005 transition provenance separate.

run_findings.candidate_013_signal_projection_contract: Default JsonlEventSink applies signal filtering before _append, while persistent Mission View projection runs only inside _append. Current durable projected set is therefore not closed under the default persistence policy.
run_findings.candidate_013_exact_static_mismatch: round.review.started is a projected type but not a SIGNAL_EVENT_TYPE and its production emitter has no text/error marker, so it is deterministically omitted by default signal before Mission View projection. engineer.progress is also projected but only conditionally persisted when its payload carries a signal marker; ordinary progress is not durable.
run_findings.candidate_013_snapshot_effect: role_activity reconstructs active-role evidence from events.jsonl and recognizes round.review.started, agent.io.start, and engineer.progress. WebAPI build_snapshot derives roles from role_activity and feeds them into snapshot_mission_view. Thus the periodic durable snapshot misses reviewer-start evidence under default signal through both persistent Mission View and the log-backed roles overlay. This does not claim downstream live sinks miss the event; JsonlEventSink still forwards filtered events downstream.
run_findings.candidate_013_fix_boundary: Promote low-volume round.review.started to signal; split high-frequency/payload-conditional engineer.progress from the durable Mission View contract or provide a separate live-only overlay. Add an invariant that every durable Mission View event type is unconditionally default-persisted, plus an end-to-end default-sink/Web snapshot regression. Do not project non-canonical filtered events into durable mission-view.json.
run_findings.candidate_012_dependency_floor: portalocker>=4.2 remains the first defensible floor for Argus's inspected raw-fd Windows locking surface; current Argus still declares portalocker>=3.
run_findings.candidate_009_mode_preservation: With a >=4.2 floor, event authority can preserve os.open(...,0600) and pass the raw fd directly to low-level Portalocker. Retry only AlreadyLocked, propagate permanent acquire failures, and prevent all post-commit unlock/fd-close cleanup failures from turning a committed append into an apparent failure.
run_findings.candidate_011_ordering_revised: Boundary isolation remains before _maybe_roll(): if nonempty current log does not end in newline, append exactly one newline under event authority before rotation, never truncate damaged bytes. Stable reading must be byte-based so torn UTF-8 cannot poison later valid rows.
run_findings.candidate_010_supervisor_contract: FOUND skips re-emit then acknowledges; ABSENT alone authorizes one re-emit after a complete stable clean scan; UNKNOWN covers snapshot/open/decode/target-relevant parse ambiguity, leaves outbox pending, and returns PLAN_RETRY without Planner invocation.
run_findings.candidate_007_windows_bootstrap_race: Mission View cross-platform reconciliation still needs event authority plus strict events.lock -> mission-view.lock and a writer projection entry point that does not recursively reacquire event authority.
run_findings.candidate_008_status: unchanged separate power-loss durability hypothesis; no power-loss incident reproduced
run_findings.candidate_005_transition_lineage_patch: optional existing Manager intent ID -> stage_history transition_id remains provenance-only and separate
